mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_schedule_task WHERE task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_lock_command SET status=#{status}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, completed_time=#{completedTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='submitted'
UPDATE sys_lock_command SET status=#{status},error_message=#{errorMessage},completed_time=#{completedTime} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='unknown'

UPDATE sys_schedule_task SET task_status=CASE WHEN loop_count=1 AND task_status=1 THEN 2 ELSE task_status END, quartz_sync_status=CASE WHEN loop_count=1 AND task_status=1 THEN 'pending' ELSE quartz_sync_status END, loop_count=CASE WHEN loop_count > 0 THEN loop_count-1 ELSE loop_count END WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND loop_count <> 0
UPDATE sys_lock_command SET status='unknown', error_message='回执超期，需人工核对设备状态' WHERE status='submitted' AND created_time < DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','+08:00'), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE)
